newsitem.title: CANADA: Alberta seeds 9 pct of crops - Alberta Wheat Pool.
newsitem.headline: Alberta seeds 9 pct of crops - Alberta Wheat Pool.

text.p: Alberta farmers seeded nine percent of crops through the week ended May 9, according to Alberta Wheat Pool's weekly crop report.
Four percent of crops were seeded at the same time last year with seeding ahead of the five and 10-year averages of seven and five percent respectively, AWP said.
"More of the crop has been seeded in the southern-most crop districts," AWP's report said. "The 1997 crop season had a slow start in northern Alberta and northeastern British Columbia."
About two million acres of the six major grains and oilseeds were not harvested in the north last fall due to early snow.
Harvesting and seeding operations in the north were impeded by cool temperatures and wet soil.

To the south, the Medicine Hat-Foremost crop district reported the most progress with 53 percent of their crops seeded, followed by Brooks-Lethbridge at 44 percent, Claresholm Cardston at 27 percent and Drumheller-Vulcan at six percent.
All other crop districts seeded three percent or less of their crops.
Soil moisture conditions declined since mid-March.
